主要内容: General Electric Co. (GE) has accused Vestas Wind Systems A/S of infringing on its wind turbine power control patent, claiming that Vestas is using its technology to protect turbines from power fluctuations. This dispute arises as the U.S. wind industry is preparing for substantial growth. According to the American Wind Energy Association, as of the end of June 2017, over 25.8 gigawatts of wind farms were under construction or in advanced development in the U.S., representing a 41 percent increase compared to the previous year. This growth is in addition to the 84 gigawatts already installed, highlighting the industry's rapid expansion.
